false_green_risks.counterexample: Only issue0 or alloc0 commits when exactly one tracker token is free.
false_green_risks.coverage: ready0=1 and ready1=0 produces zero pair fires and zero births; live count and both leases remain unchanged; split-ready and alloc0-only mutations are rejected.

false_green_risks.counterexample: The two operations share a token, truncate generation, or inherit the other lane's producer identity.
false_green_risks.coverage: Four memory pairs use eight distinct non-zero-generation full ProducerIds and distinct tokens; token-alias and PID1-truncation mutations are rejected.

false_green_risks.counterexample: Bank1 is nominal only, copies bank0 address operands, or reads perturbed live raw inputs.
false_green_risks.coverage: Both next reservations are valid and their AGUs use independently captured base/immediate values; raw perturbation has no effect; raw-fallthrough and AGU1-copy mutations are rejected.

false_green_risks.counterexample: AMO, LR, SC or FP memory enters the ordinary integer second terminal.
false_green_risks.coverage: Ten two-order cases produce no issue1, alloc1, bank1 or SQ bind1; the special-misadmission mutation is rejected.

false_green_risks.counterexample: Bank1 enters the shared request path while older bank0 is blocked.
false_green_risks.coverage: Bank1 consumes only when edge-old bank0 is empty and shared request grants bank0 first; the age-bypass mutation is rejected.

false_green_risks.counterexample: Store-store binds only one owner, crosses the two owners, or matches a truncated identity.
false_green_risks.coverage: The same capture edge binds both SQ entries by full ProducerId to distinct bank0/bank1 tokens; missing and crossed bind1 mutations are rejected.

false_green_risks.counterexample: Dual dequeue stall or bank1 cancellation loses, duplicates, or leaks a terminal tuple.
false_green_risks.coverage: Seven sparse exact-live tuples are retained under stall and drained exactly once; the bank1-cancel-leak mutation is rejected; flush clears tracker, collector and both banks.

false_green_risks.counterexample: A mutation is absent from the elaborated image or an empty structural shell satisfies the source checker.
false_green_risks.coverage: All 15 mutations compile, elaborate, activate and are rejected by dedicated oracles; source-checker vacuity and 28 checker/manifest unit tests pass.

false_green_risks.counterexample: Evidence from another RTL digest is borrowed or DI-3 is promoted to overall/PPA.
false_green_risks.coverage: All four manifest records bind design_id sha256:913023efa40ab33e4505bde3561a9fce3b392b3b44c90c8f3e5bbc9ab67195de; release/assert evidence is independent and the architecture boundary remains RED outside the named gates.
